# 1066 Paintball

> 1066 Paintball is set in acres of battle ready countryside on the outskirts of Hastings. All the equipment and instructions you need, across a wide variety of missions played out in our own battlezones: open fields with bases and barricades, and camouflaged woodland.

1066 Paintball is an outdoor paintball site at Adams Fruit Farm, Ivyhouse Lane, Hastings, East Sussex TN35 4NN, United Kingdom.

## Key facts

- Price: from £30 per person for a full day
- Minimum age: 10 years attained; under 16s need written parental permission
- Minimum group size to hold an event: 10 players
- Runs fortnightly on Saturdays, all year, by prior booking
- Booking is through Eventbrite: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/paintball-skirmish-event-tickets-1095197006729?aff=oddtdtcreator
- Telephone 07722 22 1066 (24 hour answering service), email dom@1066paintball.com
- Battlezones: The Village, Hellfire Hill, The Jungle
- Arrive 09:00
- Lunch around 12:30, for about 45 minutes; we close around 15:30
